ecb.label: Inflation risk balance
ecb.scope: ECB opening statements only. An observation requires an explicit assessment of risks to inflation or price stability. Two-sided means the same passage identifies both upside and downside inflation scenarios. It need not mean equal weight. Rate-only releases, growth risks and comparative language without a clear tilt remain unclassified. Opposing explicit tilts at different horizons are left open.
